description: Implement CaptureBackend for Windows using DXGI Desktop Duplication API (IDXGIOutputDuplication). Delivers GPU-resident ID3D11Texture2D frames. Handles: output enumeration, AcquireNextFrame with configurable timeout, cursor compositing toggle, desktop switch events, and DXGI_ERROR_ACCESS_LOST recovery. Target: sustained 60fps capture at 4K with < 1ms acquire latency. This is the primary capture path for maximum performance.
title: DXGI Desktop Duplication capture backend
